description: M4 audit finding F3 (issue #405): the declaration-slot rule checks a `struct` type name against Data-primitive names when the `data` profile is active, so `struct dict` raises `ol-reserved-word` statically -- the static counterpart to the existing runtime fixture `data/struct-runtime/struct-reserved-word-primitive`. Issue #838 dropped the `namespace: "primitive"` param this pinned (spec/error-model.md:125 gives `params: { name }` only); the runtime sibling still carries it, because #839 owns the runtime half of that removal.

diagnostics.message: dict is already part of OpenLogo. Choose another name.
